series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 5 of 7

beats.vo: You don't need technique for your first time. You need one thing.
beats.visual_intent: One lamp glowing in a dark room. Single subject, high contrast. No people.

beats.vo: This is number five of the seven things nobody tells you; follow for all of them, number one changes everything.
Five: the only real skill is paying attention. Watch her, notice what she responds to, do more of that.
beats.visual_intent: Tuning in, listening closely: a record player needle on vinyl, close up. No people.

beats.vo: That's the whole thing. Guys waste the entire time stuck in their own head, worrying about their performance.
beats.visual_intent: A busy, spinning mind: night traffic light trails or city lights blurring past. Motion, no people.

beats.vo: Get out of your head and put your attention on her instead.
beats.visual_intent: Calm focus on one thing: a single candle flame in a dim room. No people.

beats.vo: Number four is the one nobody thinks about — and it prevents most of the disasters.
beats.visual_intent: Two mugs on a table in warm lamp light, set up for a conversation. No people.
